question: how much of the single-frame focal error measured in CAM-EXP-003 was caused by using a pinhole camera model on lenses that have real radial distortion
not_in_scope: hand geometry as a calibration cue

frames.note: identical frames to CAM-EXP-003 so every comparison is paired

A_RAW_PINHOLE.source: CAM-EXP-003 predictions reused verbatim, not re-run

C_GT_UNDISTORTED_PINHOLE.description: image undistorted with the GT distortion, then the unchanged pinhole models
C_GT_UNDISTORTED_PINHOLE.why: needs the ground-truth distortion, so it is an oracle diagnostic only and is never reported as deployment performance

metrics: identical to CAM-EXP-003 - run_benchmark.to_row is imported and reused so 'relative focal error' means the same thing

paired_statistics.unit: per frame, same image in both conditions

distortion_comparison: see distortion_model_audit.md; AnyCalib and GeoCalib radial k1/k2 share the OpenCV convention so coefficients are compared directly
why_5_pct: imported from CAM-EXP-002: 5 % focal error ~ 32.8 mm of depth displacement on this data. Nothing here measures depth.
